comments.actofauthority: Consistent type who goes well for Lewis Saunders; second at Cheltenham Festival latest
comments.barrylyndon: Better than ever with 2m4f win latest and shapes as if he'll prove effective around 3m
comments.billjoyce: 2m4f Grade 2 novice winner; up in trip for handicap debut with tongue-tie added
comments.bozenith: Never going when Imperial Cup favourite and now up markedly in trip with cheekpieces on
comments.buildingbridges: In good form last summer/autumn on Flat and over hurdles and has won when fresh before
comments.catchhimderry: Excellent third in Pertemps at Cheltenham and top yard has won this three times since 2019
comments.dartan: 2nd over fences last August but well held in hurdle/Flat race since; off for 188 days
comments.deepcave: Fourth to Titan Discovery at Windsor (3m) in January but a lesser run at Sandown since
comments.dinons: In good form in first half of the season but returns from six months off in a hot race
comments.doublepowerful: Progressive, winning six on spin before good placed efforts last twice; respected up at 3m
comments.jerikodureponet: Good placed efforts around 3m last twice, latterly second in Pertemps Final at Cheltenham
comments.jipcot: Never involved in Coral Cup but in good form prior to that, including at 3m
comments.kamsinas: Looked suited to 3m when second at Doncaster latest; unexposed as a stayer
comments.maximilian: A top novice hurdler in 2022-23 but off until pulled up at Chepstow in February
comments.navajoindy: Off bridle early when in frame in strong 2m races last twice, so much longer trip may suit
comments.nursesusan: Off for 14 months prior to well held in the Martin Pipe and Harry Skelton looks elsewhere
comments.parkofkings: In good form in competitive events around 2m4f; shapes as if should be as effective at 3m
comments.pushthebutton: Stayed on for creditable sixth in Martin Pipe, shaping as if return to 3m will suit
comments.rushmount: Going right way, scoring readily at Thurles last month; probably more to come from him
comments.shanaghbob: Well behind Jeriko Du Reponet and Catch Him Derry in the Pertemps Final; others preferred
comments.timmytuesday: Has won both handicap starts around 2m4f and trying 3m should suit; interesting runner
comments.whatcouldhavebeen: Dual hurdle winner; shaped as if return to 3m will suit when fifth of 16 over 2m4f latest

verdict.comment: First and second in previous renewals of this race, veteran SAM BROWN gets the vote ahead of Imperial Saint.

comments.charlieuberalles: Won at Doncaster in December but pulled up at Kempton since and out of the handicap today
comments.cruzcontrol: Won this last year; a return to form is needed back from a break but he's not ruled out
comments.docpickedme: 9yo who has been better than ever in good handicaps at Doncaster the last twice; chance
comments.doctorken: Returned from an absence with promising second in November; very much of interest
comments.erneriver: Best run for a while when fourth at Doncaster latest but he needs to build on that today
comments.frerobanbou: Won in November when upped to an extended 2m7f but hasn't shone the last twice
comments.happygolucky: Very lightly raced since winning this in 2021; encouraging run at Cheltenham last month
comments.heltenham: Won off 2lb higher last March but over 2m4f; below par this season, including at 3m
comments.imperialsaint: Stamina to prove now up in trip but 3-3 here; could play leading role if seeing it out
comments.lemilos: Snapped losing sequence at Warwick in February but this 10yo was only 6th at Newbury since
comments.myretown: Easily made all in the Ultima and this exciting 8yo could take a 15lb rise in his stride
comments.peakyboy: Disappointing on stable debut at Ascot but this lightly raced 7yo was promising previously
comments.richmondlake: Pulled up at Cheltenham Festival but has a useful record here; e-w claims back at Aintree
comments.sambrown: 13yo who has a lofty mark, but won last time and has a good record in this race; respected
comments.shakemuparry: Won off this mark at 2024 Cheltenham Festival (2m4f); doubts about trip and current form
comments.weveallbeencaught: Ran well when 13l fourth in the Kim Muir last month and he might not be far away

races.raceComment: cruzcontrol is marginally preferred with a score of 65.1%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over docpickedme. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 4 wins from 14 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/17 at aintree. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form and improving, though returning from absence and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: With further improvement plausible, GWENNIE MAY BOY is preferred. Last year's winner Strong Leader is second choice.

comments.altobelli: Two from two since wearing cheekpieces but has something to prove upped in trip/class
comments.buddyone: Second in this contest 12 months ago but has limitations, being 0-7 at Grade 1 level
comments.dasheldrasher: Not the force of old; soundly beaten in this race for the last two years; opposed
comments.gwenniemayboy: Record includes emphatic wins on this card last year and a Grade 2 on latest start
comments.hiddenvalleylake: Creditable third in this contest 12 months ago; flopped badly in lower grade last time
comments.homebythelee: Successful in two Graded races this term; hampered and unseated rider in Stayers' Hurdle
comments.jetara: Sole attempt over 3m resulted in Grade 2 mares' win; this is a stiffer assignment
comments.kitzbuhel: Two from two since joining Willie Mullins; interesting, assuming he stays the new trip
comments.monmiral: Creditable second in Grade 2 contests the last twice but this is harder
comments.soundsrussian: Has shown best form over fences; bottom of this pack on hurdles figures
comments.strongleader: Best to forgive last two efforts; registered a clearcut win in this race 12 months ago
comments.teahupoo: Far from discredited when bidding for a second Stayers' Hurdle win; again top on ratings
comments.thewallpark: Made the frame in the Long Walk and Stayers' Hurdle since upped to Grade 1 level

races.raceComment: gwenniemayboy is marginally preferred with a score of 61.9%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive and more reliable profile over strongleader. Won 4 of last 6 starts. Excellent course form of 6/12 at aintree. Key attributes include excellent form and optimal distance and strong course form and positive comments and improving, though inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.beauport: Going left-handed is a concern but there are lots of positives otherwise

comments.monbeggenius: 13l fourth in the Welsh National; dictated pace for a Uttoxeter win (3m, soft) in February
comments.nickrockett: Never better but had good scrap last time with Intense Raffles, who's now 15lb better off
comments.percevallegallois: Won big 3m handicap from off the pace at Leopardstown (good to yielding) over Christmas
comments.royalepagaille: All wins on soft/heavy; class act over the extended 3m1f at Haydock but out of form lately
comments.seniorchief: Lightly raced 8yo; Cheltenham win (3m1f, good) in October means he needs a second look
comments.stayawayfay: Career has taken a spectacular wrong turn but there was a slight hint of better last time

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: It may be worth going with ANGLO SAXSON who has won four times here and is 3lb below his last winning mark.

comments.anglosaxson: Four-time winner over 7f/1m here and 3lb below his last winning mark; worth a second look
comments.artificer: In good form on the AW lately; respected if continuing the progress back on grass
comments.eightmile: Failed to beat a rival on stable debut/reappearance last month; needs to leave that behind
comments.embarked: 14lb lower than when winning at Southwell last September, but 0-13 since and 0-21 on turf
comments.glastonbury: Sole win came over C&D (soft) in October; quicker ground poses a question
comments.junglecruise: Open to improvement on turf/handicap debut and worth a market check
comments.keeninterest: 3lb below last winning mark; running well when last seen on turf last summer; shortlisted
comments.kranjcar: Has undergone wind surgery but has something to prove under the conditions; cheekpieces on
comments.maguire: Little to get excited about in eight starts on the AW; looks up against it on turf debut
comments.moreginplease: 1-33 but placed in three of her five starts here last year; could outrun her odds
comments.ohsoaudacious: Consistent last year; conditions should be ideal and another big effort not a surprise
comments.risingforce: Third of 21 at Doncaster last Sunday; runs off the same mark and a player if backing it up
comments.tambourinedream: 0-9; return to a 0-60 a positive, but she made a low-key stable debut last month
comments.twilightguest: 0-25 and returns from another three months off; others more compelling
comments.waistcoat: 0-7 but was sent off just 7-4 for his penultimate start; may have a bigger effort in him
comments.windsorpass: 1-32 and another placing may be her best hope

races.raceComment: anglosaxson is marginally preferred with a score of 54.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over keeninterest. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: Most of the runners are interesting. REGAL AGENDA is the suggested first choice ahead of Lady Ridgewood.

comments.casadesalinas: Kempton winner; faces stiffer task under 7lb penalty but is open to progress
comments.clermontferrand: 4yo filly who is a sibling to three winners; market helpful on belated debut
comments.ladyridgewood: Showed clear promise, including at Yarmouth, last autumn; enters calculations
comments.naga: Showed ability amid greenness at Southwell in sole 2yo run; possibilities
comments.regalagenda: Ran well (behind bright prospect) at Yarmouth when last seen; leading player
comments.tattycoram: Promising third at Ascot in a race won by the subsequent Fillies' Mile third
comments.winterssong: Sibling to six winners, out of a Group/Grade 1 scorer; interesting newcomer

races.raceComment: tattycoram is marginally preferred with a score of 19.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over regalagenda. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.alioski: First run after wind surgery when finishing well for second at Southwell
comments.bellabluesky: Four-time winner but has beaten only three rivals in as many races since last May
comments.blacksmoke: Not sure what happened back here 24 days ago but has form claims
comments.courageousgold: Improved fourth on handicap debut here when never ideally positioned
comments.fineprint: 0-18 but has placed form on turf/AW and didn't run too badly the last time
comments.oceanridge: Has only won a classified race and has been thoroughly unconvincing this year
comments.tarjamah: Won here as a 2yo but has regressed badly and was tailed off at Southwell in February
comments.twoplustwo: Did well to be second over 1m4f here on Tuesday after challenging wide; thereabouts
comments.zooks: Off the mark at Chelmsford and then wasn't beaten far off this mark 24 days ago

races.raceComment: bellabluesky is confidently preferred with a score of 58.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions over blacksmoke. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 2 wins from 7 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
